about.tagline: AI agent IM workspace · runtime built on pi
about.piDesc: Providers, model catalog and auth follow pi's official implementation.

settings.aboutDesc: A local-first agent workspace. The daemon owns the data; this shell only renders it.

llm.desc: Providers and models come from pi's built-in catalog; the default model and thinking level apply to the runtime.
llm.keyHint: Stored only in the main process, encrypted with the OS keychain.
llm.title: LLM models
llm.defaultDesc: Used when a new agent conversation starts.
llm.thinkingHint: Only applies to models that support reasoning.
llm.defaultNotReady: Default provider "{{name}}" is {{status}}; the runtime cannot use that model.
llm.providersDesc: {{curated}} curated providers listed; pi ships {{total}} in total.
llm.catalogFootnote: See /model in pi for the full catalog.
llm.descAll: pi ships {{providers}} providers and ~{{models}} models; all of them are reachable here, with prices taken from pi's catalog and editable in place.
llm.providersDescAll: {{count}} providers, grouped as official / subscription / cloud / gateway / China / other.
llm.idHint: Unique id, written into config and the ledger.
llm.apiHint: pi supports {{count}} API kinds; all are selectable here.
llm.fetchRequested: Fetch requested (had {{before}} models); success depends on the provider's /models endpoint and key
llm.apiKeyOnly: This provider logs in with an API key — no OAuth
llm.removeConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” with its models and key? This cannot be undone.

compaction.desc: When the context approaches the model limit, older turns are summarized. Thresholds are relative to the selected model's window.
compaction.modelHint: Thresholds are computed against this model's context window.
compaction.title: Context compaction
compaction.sectionDesc: Summarize older turns before the request would be cut off.
compaction.reserveHint: Start compacting when free context drops below this; recommended {{recommended}}.
compaction.backgroundHint: Start a background compaction this much earlier; 0 disables.
compaction.footnote: Passed straight to pi's compaction policy; applies to the next run.

image.desc: pi's image model type. The default image model will drive visual deliverables.
image.empty: No image models exposed by the current providers.
image.emptyHint: pi's built-in catalog has image models, but our OpenAI-compatible endpoints only list text models. They appear here once a provider with image support is connected.
image.footnote: The generation pipeline (generateImages → artifact) is not wired yet; this page only stores the default.
image.title: Image models
image.descSuffix: with {{count}} built-in models, all served by OpenRouter.
image.providerDesc: Shares credentials and auth with LLM · OpenRouter.
image.sharedKey: Image and text models share the OpenRouter API key; configure it once on the LLM page.
image.generateDesc: Calls the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (/images/generations); the file is stored in the local images directory.
image.promptPlaceholder: Describe the image, e.g. a shiba inu wearing headphones, flat illustration
image.pickModelFirst: Pick an image model below first
image.descProvider: Image models belong to providers: any provider with a key and an image model can generate.
image.emptyProvider: No image models yet — add one below, or configure OpenRouter on the LLM page.
image.providersDesc: Providers that own image models. Custom endpoints show up here after you add them.
image.protocolHint: openai-images uses the OpenAI-compatible /images/generations; openrouter-images is pi's native image API. Both go through the same HTTP pipeline today.

selfcheck.desc: Live checks for native modules, sandbox, persistence and process isolation.

settings.appearanceDesc: The shell ships light-first; the dark theme is adapted in step.
settings.fontSizeHint: Scales the whole interface proportionally (like browser zoom).
settings.fontHint: Uses fonts already installed; no network fetch.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.hint: USD per 1M tokens, cache priced separately. "Use pi prices" fills the full cost incl. context tiers.
pricing.applied: Matched {{matched}} models against pi's official pricing; {{unmatched}} had no match (left unknown, never invented)

auth.title: Sign-in & credentials
auth.hint: OAuth is implemented by pi's provider (PKCE / device codes); credentials are stored locally in credentials.json and resolved by pi per request.

facts.title: Company facts
facts.desc: Facts written here enter every employee's prompt; writing the same subject supersedes the old value (history kept).
facts.subject: Subject, e.g. Q4 goal

org.title: Org chart
org.description: Departments, reporting lines and headcount. Editing arrives with the daemon.
org.comingSoon: The org chart unlocks once the daemon is connected
org.descReal: {{departments}} departments · {{members}} employees. Hiring, transferring and firing immediately affect dispatch and budget.
org.name: Name
org.head: Head
org.hireHint: Hiring creates employee, position and budget together
org.modelHint: Leave empty for the default model
org.focusHint: Focused on {{name}}; other departments are outside the current range
org.boardHint: All departments; pick one in the directory to focus
org.rosterHint: Whole-company roster; pick a department in the directory to focus
org.boardDragHint: Drag a card into another department to transfer
org.boardEmpty: No members yet — drag one in or hire
org.fireConfirm: Dismiss “{{name}}”? They will leave the org chart.
org.deptCodeHint: Unique in the company, e.g. PD-01
org.deptDescriptionHint: What this department owns and delivers
org.deptDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. turn the boss's ideas into verifiable deliverables
org.headHint: Optional: appoint a head, who moves into this department
org.deptRulesEmpty: No rules yet — anything you write here enters every member's prompt.

market.title: Talent market
market.description: Browse, interview and hire agent employees.
market.comingSoon: The talent market unlocks once the daemon is connected
market.descPool: {{count}} people in the talent pool — alumni and anyone not yet placed, kept out of the org chart.
market.poolDesc: Placing someone restores their position, reporting line and active status immediately.
market.externalDesc: Hire new agents from the market
market.externalHint: An external listing catalog (official/community listings, interviews, ratings) needs a cloud marketplace as its source and is not connected yet. For now, hire directly from the org page or import an employee package.
market.footnote: "Unassigned" is not a department — it is a pool of people without a position, which is why it lives here.
market.heroDesc: Import a local agent package and hire in one click: the agent joins the chosen department with its skills and charter, and the 1v1 chat opens immediately.
market.emptyHint: Import a local agent package (.json); each agent becomes a candidate you can hire one by one.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: There is no view at this address.

desktopOnly.title: Launch the desktop app
desktopOnly.description: This UI is only loaded by the Electron main process. Run pnpm dev in the project root instead of opening it in a browser.

notifications.title: Notifications & guards
notifications.subtitle: Who is waiting, who was held back, who is talking to whom — every row is a database row, not an estimate.
notifications.inboxHint: What employees still owe after hours. Woken now bypasses the heartbeat; queued waits for it.
notifications.guardsHint: Quota spent, rate exceeded, no answer given — silence keeps its reason.
notifications.guardsEmpty: Nobody has been held back yet.
notifications.relationshipsHint: Directional edges: strength grows with interaction; the kind is the role you play in their eyes.
notifications.quotasHint: Once the daily quota is spent, later messages only queue.
notifications.dismissed: Dismissed {{count}} guard record(s) — kept for audit, just out of the way
notifications.guardQuota: Quota spent — {{from}}'s message was downgraded to a queued note

reason.no_model: No model configured, so the employee could not answer; the message stays in the thread for a human.
reason.model_failed: The model call failed; the items went back to the queue for the next heartbeat.
reason.limit_reached: This thread hit its turn limit, so automatic replies stopped and it is waiting for you.
reason.escalated: This thread is escalated: automatic replies between the two employees are paused.

task.acceptanceHint: The checker is written to checks/ by the system and cannot be edited by the employee; it runs with the task workspace as cwd.

template.imageHint: Acceptance only requires an image file served over HTTP with 200 and an image/* type; quality is the model's call.

budget.blockedHint: Available tokens do not cover this estimate. Raise the budget or lower the estimate.
